title: Constructive CLM-001 — Learned Coordinate Formation
decision_question: Can a continual learner form reusable Cell effect coordinates and matching read keys from structured experience, without task/factor labels, while growth stops after the reusable factors have been acquired?

world.curriculum: factors appear without labels; each novel factor first appears alone, then participates in repeated and compositional transactions; a late consolidation region contains only reuse/recombination
world.heldout: all singleton factors and all pairwise compositions with fresh noise
world.oracle_use: factor IDs define the hidden world and post-hoc metrics only; learner methods receive only x,y,phase

learner.read: cosine-key top-k routing followed by temperature-softmax composition
learner.birth: residual/loss-triggered probationary Cell initialized from current transaction means only
learner.reuse_update: local key/value EMA on currently routed examples only

controls.shuffled_address: preserve target effects and transaction counts while permuting transaction contexts, breaking stable read->effect structure
controls.independent_memory: description-cost baseline represented by one independent memory per transaction

interpretation.positive: Structured continual pressure can produce a bounded reusable Cell coordinate/read-key system in the controlled world. This closes G1 only and opens long-horizon growth validation.
interpretation.negative: The current constructive coordinate/read-key mechanism is insufficient even in a favorable controlled world. Do not proceed to language-scale native-CLM claims until G1 is redesigned.
not_established: Core-005 certificate integration with learned coordinates
